name: PromptHomePage

states.name: Page Layout & Structure
states.description: The page is a full-height centered flex column with the app wordmark, a search-style input bar, suggestion chips, and an explain toggle. Content is vertically and horizontally centered.

states.name: App Wordmark
states.description: A subtle 'qontinui' wordmark with a Sparkles icon appears above the input, establishing brand identity without dominating the page.

states.name: Search Input Bar
states.description: The primary input — a rounded search bar with a search icon, placeholder text, and a submit arrow that appears when text is entered.

states.name: Suggestion Chips
states.description: Below the input, suggestion chips show recent prompts (if history exists) or example prompts for new users. Chips are rounded-full pill buttons.
states.precondition: Page is in idle state (no active execution) and no prompt history exists

states.name: Explain Steps Toggle
states.description: A checkbox toggle below suggestions that enables tutorial overlay narration during execution. Persisted to instanceStorage.

states.name: Planning State
states.description: After submission, the page shows a spinner with 'Understanding your request...' while the AI plans the action sequence.
states.precondition: A prompt has just been submitted and the backend is generating a plan

states.name: Executing State — Step Progress
states.description: During execution, the page displays the AI's plan summary and a step-by-step progress list. Each step shows a status icon (done/current/pending) and its explanation text.
states.precondition: Page is in executing phase with a plan loaded

states.name: Done State
states.description: After all steps complete, shows a green 'Done!' message with a 'Start another task' link to reset.
states.precondition: All plan steps have completed successfully

states.name: Error State
states.description: If planning or execution fails, shows a red error message with Retry and Start over options.
states.precondition: The backend returned an error or a step failed during execution

states.name: Self-Steering Execution — Domain Logic
states.description: The core feature: the runner steers itself by using the UI Bridge state machine for navigation and NLActionExecutor for page interactions. The AI plans a sequence of navigate + action steps, and the runner executes them visibly.
states.precondition: A navigate step is executing during plan execution

description: Prompt Home — the runner's Google-style landing page. Users type a natural language request (e.g., 'schedule a workflow at 3am'), the AI plans a sequence of UI actions, and the runner steers itself via the state machine and NLActionExecutor. Optional 'Explain steps' mode narrates each action via tutorial overlays.
